WardrobeItem.title: WardrobeItem
WardrobeItem.description: A clothing item stored in the user's Smart Digital Wardrobe.

userId.description: The authenticated UID of the wardrobe item owner.

name.description: Display name of the clothing item (1 to 100 characters).

imageUrl.description: Base64 data URI or preset visual asset identifier for the clothing item photo.

weather.description: Weather suitability for the clothing item.

style.description: Style classification for the clothing item.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was created (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was last updated (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/wardrobe/{itemId}.description: Collection of clothing items in the Smart Digital Wardrobe scoped by userId.
